channel.title: Voice of Startup Bangladesh
channel.description: Verified Bangladesh startup, business and investment news

item.title: The government wants to make a Bengali model of AI, talks with four institutions
item.description: The government is planning to create its own model of artificial intelligence (AI) in Bengali. For this, the country wants to build a strong computer and server infrastructure.

item.title: Zahidul returned to the United States and is now a successful agricultural entrepreneur
item.description: After spending almost a century and a half abroad, he returned to the country and established himself as an agricultural entrepreneur. Zahidul Islam. Originally, his venture started with the idea of ​​unadulterated crops, later it took a commercial form.

item.title: Sahabuddin, an engineer in the sugarcane business, left his job
item.description: He has cultivated sugarcane on 100 bighas of land in that area through contract farming. Due to his initiative, Amrit variety sugarcane is becoming popular in the area.

item.title: Nazma Akhter earns lakhs of taka per month by making fish chips
item.description: Many people started online business at the beginning of Corona. He also made a profit. From that idea, in 2020, entrepreneur Nazma Akhter started an online business of girls' beauty products.

item.title: Need 20 lakhs, bank wants to give 5 lakhs, entrepreneurs are not getting loans as per demand
item.description: Hatbox, a souvenir manufacturing small and medium enterprise (SME), applies for a CC loan (business management loan) of Tk 20 lakh from a private bank. But the bank doesn't want to give more than Tk 4-5 lakh loan.

item.title: When an AI Summit Becomes an API Summit
item.description: Bangladesh's first national AI business summit, held in Dhaka on 5 November, was billed as a step towards a technology-driven economy.

item.title: 90 thousand MSME entrepreneurs have received cyber security training
item.description: Asia Foundation and Sajeda Foundation have conducted nationwide training programs to raise awareness about cyber security.

item.title: Buy a flat or invest elsewhere

item.title: 5 types of punishment including disconnection of gas and electricity for non-payment of income tax return
item.description: You have not filed income tax return. Think what will happen to you. If the tax officials are strict, the fine can be up to 50 thousand rupees. Even the gas-electricity connection may be cut off.

item.title: Household expenses are increasing, how to save savings
item.description: In 2021, Azhar Hossain (pseudonym) lived on 50 thousand taka per month. Apart from this, some money was also in hand. He used to save that money. But in the last few years, the cost of daily necessities, house rent, children's education and transportation have increased.

item.title: Loan transfer facility at BRAC Bank at 9 percent interest, no additional cost
item.description: BRAC Bank has announced the purchase (takeover) of personal loans (personal loans) and housing loans (home loans) in any bank or financial institution at low interest. Under this special offer, customers will have to pay 9 percent interest in the first year.

item.title: Why did the speed of transactions in Bangla QR stopped?
item.description: The 'Bangla QR' initiative launched to popularize digital transactions by reducing the use of cash has largely stalled. Initially, the transaction speed was promising but in recent times it has declined.

item.title: 55% of private sector workers use AI, MetLife survey
item.description: Artificial intelligence or AI is becoming a major hope for reducing stress among workers in a rapidly changing workplace. About 55 percent or more than half of the country's private sector workforce is currently using AI.
